title: Aizawa style
features:
simple script about Yakuza 5 final boss Masato Aizawa moveset replaces frenzy

StanceStrike is 龍TigerDrop

GrabStrike (or counterquickstep) is T_龍GParry

Fallen enemy heat act uses FallenBeatdown and FallenKick

new heat action for bat weapons

time for resolve Invulnerable buff (reused from shishido style because I'm lazy)

no double finishing blows

yellow and pink aura (probably)

also execute this for rush stancestrike to work correctly

if game.ReplicatedStorage.Styles.Rush:FindFirstChild("StanceStrike") then
v = game.ReplicatedStorage.Styles.Rush["StanceStrike"]
else
v = Instance.new("StringValue", game.ReplicatedStorage.Styles.Rush)
end
v.Value = '龍TigerDrop'
v.Name = "StanceStrike"
